consequence.statement: Existing ClusterSecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. Operators need to run a storage version migration that rewrites all objects, then update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, rewrite all ClusterSecretStore objects so they are stored as v1. Then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions on the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD.

assertion.statement: From chart 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io moves from v1beta1 to v1. Existing ClusterSecretStore objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v1beta1.
